text:
maria-support: heads up — started seeing p99 latency regressions (~600ms -> ~1.2s) for model `redwood-xl-v2-int8` after we pushed the new quantization profile to tenant-43 at 09:12 UTC. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate (multi-tenant). :frowning:
alex-ml: can you paste a few request ids and the perf trace? is it across all sequence lengths?
maria-support: quick sample from logs (request ids scrubbed):\n```\nreq=01FJ3... tenant=tenant-43 model=redwood-xl-v2-int8 p50=220ms p95=640ms p99=1.18s seq=256
req=01FJ4... tenant=tenant-43 model=redwood-xl-v2-int8 p50=200ms p95=620ms p99=1.11s seq=64
```\nLooks like p99 rises even at short seqs. Not all tenants hit — tenant-12 unchanged.
ingrid-runtime: do we have the quant profile id that was rolled? could be an int8 path that triggers a slow kernel on certain hardware.
maria-support: profile id `qp-2026-03-int8-v3`, applied via canary to 10% of tenants, then auto-roll at ~09:10.
shawn-sre: I see the traces in jaeger for those req ids — KV cache miss rate spiked concurrently. Might be cache key mismatch after the profile changed (different cache keys for quantized variant). :thinking:
alex-ml: if kv cache misses increased, that would amplify p99. Can we force fallback to fp16 for tenant-43 while we triage?
maria-support: please — customers are complaining. How fast can we toggle?
ingrid-runtime: we have a per-tenant runtime override. Ops command below will pin model variant to fp16 for tenant-43: \n```bash
redwoodctl tenant update tenant-43 --model-override redwood-xl-v2-fp16 --until 2026-03-17T12:00:00Z
```\nI can run if approved.
shawn-sre: +1 run it, also put a temporary traffic-splitting rule to send 100% of tenant-43 to the dedicated fp16 variant.
ops-bot: @ingrid-runtime permission check passed for tenant update.\n
deploy-bot: Rollout job queued: pin-model-tenant-43 -> redwood-xl-v2-fp16 (job id jb-99821).
deploy-bot: Rollout succeeded: tenant-43 now pinned to fp16 variant. (ts: 3034567910)
maria-support: confirming with customer now — will update.
alex-ml: next steps: 1) reproduce locally with qp-2026-03-int8-v3 + identical hw profile, 2) run microbenchmark for kernel selection path, 3) check cache key generation for quantized variant, 4) consider changing profile to keep fp16 KV cache semantics (or add compatibility shim).
ingrid-runtime: agree. Also flagging in monitoring to alert if p99 > 800ms for more than 3m so we catch rollouts earlier.
shawn-sre: leaving a short mitigation runbook in case it recurs: \n- Pin impacted tenants to fp16 variant
- Disable automatic full-rollout of qp-2026-03-int8-v3
- Run offline calibration diagnostics on sample model weights + hw
- If quant kernel slow, add alternative kernel selection rule to prefer fp16 on affected hw families\n
maria-support: customer confirmed latency back down after the pin. They appreciate the quick response. :thumbsup:
alex-ml: I'll open an internal ticket with repro steps and benchmark results, tag `qc/quantization` and `runtime/kv-cache`.
ops-bot: Created ticket RF-5421: "quant-profile qp-2026-03-int8-v3 causes p99 spike on certain hw; KV cache miss increase" assigned to alex-ml.
shawn-sre: closing loop — if anyone sees more tenants with similar pattern, ping this thread.
